command.name: canonical schema table list
command.run: .venv/bin/python -c "import sqlite3,tempfile,os,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from freight_recon.schema import create_canonical_schema; p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'probe.sqlite3'); c=sqlite3.connect(p); create_canonical_schema(c); print(sorted(r[0] for r in c.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type='table'\")))"
